note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF (Medford-Park Falls RD) on the South Fork Flambeau River by the Smith Rapids covered bridge. Set up as a horse camp: every site that takes a towed or driven RV (5-11) has tie stalls and hitching rails, with an equestrian lot across the road; 1-4 are tent and truck-camper sites. Carry-in canoe landing at the picnic area. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov record/catalog read: 10-11 sites, all FCFS (FS: 'There are no reservable sites'), no hookups/dump, 2 vault toilets, water, $15 (rec.gov 2027 $12), May 1 - Oct 15. DROP CANDIDATE (horse rule): FS bills it as 'a base camp that is popular for Horse Riding and Camping' and all seven RV-capable sites (5-11) are horse sites with tie stalls - no separate horse area. Not waterfront kept. Pin OK.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (horse rule): the FS page opens 'If you are looking for a base camp that is popular for Horse Riding and Camping ...' and says 'campsites are equipped with tie stalls and trailer parking designed for horse camping' and 'Seven campsites are designed to accommodate horse trailers with extra-long parking spurs (campsites: 5-11), hitching rails'. rec.gov tags 5-9 with a 'Horse Hitching Post'. Sites 1-4 are tent/truck-camper only, so every site a 23-ft motorhome fits is a horse site; there is no separate horse area. The old note's 'open to general drive-in RV camping' has no source. Reviewer decides.

BOOKING: stored FCFS kept and now sourced. The FS page's boilerplate reservation paragraph ('Sites can be reserved at www.recreation.gov') contradicts its own 'There are no reservable sites'; rec.gov lists no reservable site.

SITES: the FS page says both 'No. of Sites: 11' and 'a campground with 10 sites' / 'RV Camping No. of Sites: 10'; rec.gov lists only 2-9. Kept 11. max_rig 45 kept (sites 6-9 '45+ Foot'; rec.gov 65-75 ft).
SEASON: new - May 1 - October 15 (FS). rec.gov's 2027 FCFS season runs 04-29..10-12.
FEES: rec.gov's 2027 rate is $12 (FCFS season), the FS page says $15; range 12-15 kept.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. On Esri imagery the RV/horse sites 5-9 sit 100+ m south of the river under canopy; only tent sites 2-3 are near it (~25-40 m), and the South Fork here is ~15-20 m wide (creekside at most).
OHV: rec.gov notes the Flambeau Trail System nearby; 'Off-road vehicles are not permitted to operate in' the campground. No OHV issue.

PHONE: stored 715-762-2461 (rec.gov) - keep; the FS page lists the Medford office 715-748-4875. WEBSITE: both links live - keep. PIN 45.9102,-90.1745 is ~30 m from the FS point 45.91024,-90.174522 - keep.
